name: Sally Lieber
title: Member and 2026 Chair, California State Board of Equalization; Democratic candidate for re-election (2026)
years_of_service: Mountain View City Council 1998 to 2002 (including mayor); State Assembly (22nd District) 2002 to 2008, Speaker pro Tempore 2006 to 2008; Board of Equalization since January 2, 2023, chair in 2024 and 2026. (Wikipedia)
background: Lieber was born April 24, 1961, in Detroit. She attended City College of San Francisco and Foothill College and earned a B.A. in political science from Stanford, after about ten years restoring Victorian houses. (Wikipedia)

She served on the Mountain View City Council, including as mayor, and represented the 22nd Assembly District from 2002 to 2008, becoming Speaker pro Tempore. She authored a state minimum-wage increase and the bill creating the San Francisco Bay Restoration Authority; a planned 2007 bill to ban spanking young children drew widespread criticism. She lost a 2012 state Senate race to Jerry Hill. (Wikipedia)
She was elected to the Board of Equalization in 2022 with 69.8%, chairs the board for 2026, and placed first in the June 2026 primary with 56.8%. (Wikipedia; Ballotpedia)
